messages.text: 05:53: fog at hub, vis 150 m, field closed, forecast lift 09:30. No diversions or stuck guests so far. I'll monitor arrivals holding and stands; flag tight crew duty when they come in.

05:54 call-out: hub closed, visibility 150 m, fog forecast lifting 09:30. No diversions or stuck guests so far. Holding assessment — will pull crew duty status next to frame recovery options for approval.
Three diverted flights: 574 guests at DWC, 312 at SHJ, 1066 stuck — start care at both.
1,066 guests stuck at DWC and SHJ diversions; recommend meal and hotel arrangements pending your approval.
06:09: three diverted flights — two at DWC with 574 guests, one at SHJ with 312; 1,066 guests stuck. Hub closed until fog lifts 09:30; guest recovery notified to start care at both airports.
Diverted: DWC 2 flights, 574 guests; SHJ 1 flight, 312 guests — 1,066 stuck total. Hub closed to 09:30. I've asked the duty manager to approve meal and hotel arrangements at both airports.
Assess crew duty and rest for crews at DWC and SHJ diversions, 574 and 312 guests affected, so recovery options can be framed for approval.
Guest Recovery: recommend proceeding with meals and hotels for the 574 at DWC and 312 at SHJ, subject to human approval. Crew Control asked to assess diversion crews. Hub fog lifting 09:30.
DWC crew C07 only 62 duty minutes left (ends 07:37), below 90; SHJ C10 at 100 is tight. HUB standbys S1/S2/S3 have 565–595 minutes to cover.
DWC C07 flagged: 62 minutes duty left, ends 07:37, under 90. SHJ tightest is C10 at 100, legal. HUB standbys S1/S2/S3 hold 565–595 minutes for cover; duty manager notified.

Crew Control: noted — C07 times out 07:37, before 09:30 lift, so needs relief; C10 tight at 100. Standbys S1–S3 could road to DWC in 76 min or SHJ in 125. Proposing standby repositioning as a recovery option for the approver.
Hotline update: DWC C07 down to 44 duty minutes, C15 also caution at 67; SHJ C10 at 82 — all three need relief planning before fog lift.
Crew line so far: DWC C07 has only 44 duty minutes left, C15 also caution at 67; SHJ C10 down to 82. Passed to Crew Control for relief planning.

Hotline: DWC C07 at 41 (ends 07:37) and C15 at 64 both under 90; SHJ C10 at 79. DWC crews C01–C11 hold 224–264 minutes, SHJ C03–C14 hold 219–314, HUB standbys S1–S3 have 544–574. Relief options with duty manager.

For approver: (1) approve meals/hotels for 574 DWC, 312 SHJ; (2) position standbys — road 76 min to DWC covers C07 (40 left), C15 (63); road 125 min to SHJ covers C10 (78); (3) delay departures past 07:37/08:00/08:15 if standbys not dispatched.

Hotline update sent: DWC C07 at 41 minutes (ends 07:37) and C15 at 64 both under 90; SHJ C10 at 79. Legal cover: DWC crews 224–264, SHJ crews 219–314, HUB standbys S1–S3 at 544–574 — options with the duty manager.
Plan B approved: standby crews busing to cover C07/C15/C10; no departure delays needed for guests yet.
Duty manager notified. Holding guest services at 574 DWC / 312 SHJ pending any departure-time changes.
Plan B approved: bus S1/S2 to DWC (76 min) for C07/C15 relief, S3 to SHJ (125 min) for C10 — brief crews on arrival times.

Hotline briefed on approved plan B: S1/S2 road 76 min to DWC covering C07 (41 left) and C15 (64); S3 road 125 min to SHJ covering C10 (79). I'm not dispatching buses myself — hub control handles road moves, duty manager notified.
